modules.module_title: Prepare mud mix for drilling operation

pcs.pc_description: obtain geotechnical information of the field
design and prepare the mud mix using mud and chemical in the mud tank as per the drilling procedure and geology of drilling site
check the fluid to establish a baseline by recording different parameters such as marsh funnel viscosity, pH, fluid density, fluid loss, yield point, plastic viscosity, etc.
collect and check mud samples after every one hour with the baseline to detect and monitor any problem
make necessary adjustments in the mud viscosity, mud temperature, pH balance, and chemical components as per the requirement during the drilling process,
report any deviation in mud mix with the standard baseline to the shift incharge
store mud mix in a mud tank / suction tank
maintain the flow of mud mix from mud tank through mud pump, Standpipe and Rotary Hose to the drill Bit and returned back through Annulus /Return Line to Shaker & Mud Tanks
remove the cuttings from the mud mix using shale shaker and hydrocyclone/ centrifugal Pump
check the property of mud, degasify the mud mix in degasser in case of gas found in the mud mix
store the mud mix in the mud tank which is returned back from annulus after removal of cutting and gas
use agitator to maintain the consistency of mud mix
maintain the flow the mud mix cycle during drilling operation
